 Martinelli has knee arthroscopy and is not expected to play again in 2026 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article Fluminense announced that Martinelli underwent arthroscopic surgery on his left knee after suffering a lateral meniscus injury in the first leg of the Libertadores semifinal against Palmeiras. The defensive midfielder tried to return for the second leg but ultimately did not even make the matchday squad. According to Fluminense, the No. 8 faces a six-week recovery, meaning he is unlikely to return until next season.
